Name: Fire
Script:
// Fire - flames rise from the bottom edge, fanning out and cooling from
// yellow through orange to red as the embers age and fade.
@scene fps=30 bg=#0a0200 trail=${cooling} size=32x48

emit flames
  rate    = ${intensity} per 0.03..0.06s
  origin  = x:rand y:bottom
  vel     = dir:up speed:${rise} spread:34
  gravity = up 6
  color   = pick(#ff3300,#ff6a00,#ff9a00,#ffcc33)
  colorshift = -35
  life    = 0.8..1.5s
